output.subject: Invoice INV-1187: $28,000
output.body:
Hello Evergreen Home team,

I hope all is well. This is a friendly reminder about invoice INV-1187 for $28,000, which is due Dec 10. Could you let me know when we can expect payment, and confirm it will reach us no later than Dec 18?

If anything is holding it up or you need anything from us, please let me know and I will gladly help sort it out.

Thank you,
Cascade Trade Co.
